title: hornerFromTop: the synthetic-division partial-sum accumulator, built by nested Nat.rec
statement: Complex.hornerFromTop c a m j is the synthetic-division accumulator for dividing the degree-<=m+1 polynomial with coefficient function c by (X - a), computed by a nested Nat.rec (outer on m, inner on j): hornerFromTop c a 0 j = c 0 for any j; hornerFromTop c a (m+1) 0 = c (m+1); hornerFromTop c a (m+1) (j+1) = hornerFromTop c a m j + a^(j+1) * c(m+1). A total, axiom-free definition; never extracts an existing quotient via Exists-elimination.
